run_f_gold: run f_gold to convert a binary number integer to its decimal value
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple binary inputs to verify correct decimal conversion
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use Python built-in int(n, 2) for binary to decimal conversion
review_f_gold: review f_gold which converts a binary integer to decimal using digit-by-digit base multiplication
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that processes binary digits right to left accumulating powers of two
